rule: Every department handoff must include an exact canonical chat title plus the activation command. Operational identity comes from the role/packet on disk, not from the UI title alone.
rotation: Increment the desk number only when that department chat is archived/retired and a replacement chat is opened.
fallback: If ChatGPT auto-generates another title, the handoff still works because the pasted command and durable packet identify the role. Rename the chat manually to the canonical title for clean tracking.
